999008199.text: これで……終わりだよ！！

localizations.en: And that's... the end of that!!

999008199.text: ひ、ひぃっ！
ハイディ、あちらにお父様が逃げていきます

localizations.en: Heidi, your father is making a run for it.

999008199.text:
ったく、逃げ足だけは昔から速いんだから……。
家出してから鍛えた追跡術、見せてやるか

localizations.en: Ugh, he's always been quick on his feet... Guess I'll show him what years of tracking practice can do.

999008199.text:
父さん、もう逃げられないよ。
観念して話して

localizations.en: You can't keep running, Dad. Just stop and talk to me.

999008199.text:
許してくれ！
本気で決闘がしたいわけじゃなかったんだ！

localizations.en: Please, forgive me! I never actually wanted a real duel!

999008199.text:
ただ母さんに、俺の知識を認めてもらいたくて……
考古学の知見で勝負しようと……

localizations.en: I just... I wanted her to acknowledge my knowledge. I thought if we had it out over archaeology...

999008199.text:
はあ？　なら、なんでゴーレムを使って暴れたのさ。
知識で勝負するつもりだったんでしょ？

localizations.en: Are you serious? Then why bring golems into it? Wasn't this supposed to be a battle of knowledge?

999008199.text:
仕方ないだろう？　まずこれくらいやらないと
見向きもされないまま捨てられてしまう……！

localizations.en: What else could I do? If I didn't make a scene, she'd never even look at me... I'd just be thrown away!

999008199.text:
捨てられるって……じゃあ、そもそも不正なんか
しなければよかったじゃん！

localizations.en: Thrown away? Well, maybe you shouldn't have falsified your research in the first place!

999008199.text:
……母さんは優秀だ。
父さんなんか足元にも及ばない

localizations.en: ...Your mother is brilliant. She's so far above me it's not even funny.

999008199.text:
でも、俺は母さんに認められたいんだ。
対等な関係になりたかった

localizations.en: But I wanted her to recognize me. To see me as her equal.

999008199.text:
そうじゃないと捨てられてしまう。
だから……功績が欲しくて……

localizations.en: Without that, she'd have no reason to stay. So I wanted achievements of my own...

999008199.text: ……馬鹿じゃないの。それ、母さんに言ったわけ？

localizations.en: ...You absolute idiot. Did you ever actually tell her any of this?

999008199.text: こんな気持ち、言えるものか！

localizations.en: How could I say something like that out loud!?

999008199.text:
つべこべ言ってる場合じゃないでしょ！
まったくもう

localizations.en: Now is not the time for excuses! Good grief...

999008199.text:
私から母さんに、父さんと話すようには言ってみるよ。
でも、今話したこと、ちゃんと母さんにも言いな

localizations.en: I'll talk to Mom and try to get her to hear you out. But you'd better say all of this to her face—every word.

999008199.text: ……私に認められたかった？

すまん、この通りだ！　
どうか俺とやり直してくれ！

localizations.en: I'm so sorry! I'm begging you—please, give us another chance!

999008199.text:
あのね、自分勝手に家を出て、挙句に決闘だなんて
言う人のこと、そう簡単に許せると思う？

localizations.en: You think it's that easy to forgive someone who walked out without a word, and then had the nerve to send a duel challenge?

999008199.text: め、面目次第もございません……
……こりゃあ、時間掛かりそうだなぁ

localizations.en: ...This is going to take a while.

999008199.text: もう、逃げないんですよね？

localizations.en: You're not going to run again, are you?

999008199.text:
……気が済むまで見守ってやるか。
家出してた分、それくらいの親孝行はしないとね

localizations.en: ...I'll keep watch until things settle down. The least I can do after being away so long.
